review.body: { let operation = cli_common :: observation :: scope ("HOST" , "sig:design:storage" , "Session::take_server_error" , & self) ; let result = self . server_error . lock () . unwrap_or_else (std :: sync :: PoisonError :: into_inner) . take () ; operation . finish (& result) ; result }
review.item_premise: The operation takes Option<ServerError> under its mutex and records only the role-only session and closed result. It clears the slot; teardown discards an unconsumed value through the same operation.
